comment: src/ColorMixer.cpp at commit b90cd69. Every layer carries the same ten controls and four jacks, so each of those gets one line and all seven rows point at it; the row's own number is printed beside it. The composite is done in processLayer() and composite() at lines 106-130: Normal interpolates by alpha, Addition adds the top times alpha, Multiply, Screen and Overlay are the usual formulas with alpha folded in, and only Normal changes the running alpha. The clamp switch decides whether the running colour is held to 0 to 1 after each layer, once at the end, or never, so with it Off the outputs can leave the 0V to 10V range. The panel prints Lights with All, 2 and 1 beside its switch, Clamp with All, End and Off, the five blend-mode names in their lamp colours, Background Color, and HSV, RGB and Off beside the background switch.
